title: Infant/Toddler Lead Teacher
description: Lead daily curriculum and nurturing care for our youngest learners ages 6 weeks–2 years. CDA or Associate's degree preferred.

title: Preschool Teacher (Ages 3–5)
description: Design and deliver play-based learning experiences for preschool-age children.

title: Floater Teacher
description: Support classrooms across age groups as needed. Flexible hours, great for part-time work.

title: Administrative Assistant
description: Support center operations, family communications, and enrollment coordination.

title: Lead Preschool Teacher
description: Lead a classroom of 3–5 year olds with a focus on school-readiness and social-emotional learning.

title: Teacher's Aide
description: Assist lead teachers with daily activities, supervision, and classroom management. Entry-level — training provided.

title: Kitchen / Nutrition Aide
description: Prepare nutritious meals and snacks for children. Food handler certification required.

title: After-School Program Teacher
description: Supervise and engage school-age children (K–5) in homework help, enrichment activities, and outdoor play.

title: Infant Caregiver
description: Provide attentive, loving care for infants 6 weeks–12 months. Experience with infants strongly preferred.

title: Toddler Room Teacher
description: Support the developmental milestones of toddlers ages 1–3 through structured play and sensory activities.

title: Facility & Maintenance Aide
description: Keep our center clean, safe, and well-maintained. Responsibilities include cleaning, minor repairs, and supply restocking.

title: Center Director (Assistant)
description: Assist the center director with staff scheduling, licensing compliance, family relations, and daily operations.
